assertions: The portable bundle includes the complete Phase 4 artifact chain and exported runtime schemas.
Every exported entry has a relative path, byte size, media type, contract type, and SHA-256 digest.
Prior-phase references remain relative and no provider is required to load the bundle.
Strict reload validates contract types, digests, stale-report state, and manifest integrity.
Replay produces the same manifest identity for the same artifact set.
Corrupt, missing, absolute, or type-incompatible entries are refused.
limitations: The portable evidence bundle does not redistribute optional provider models.
Referenced source media remains governed by the workspace export policy.
